string.text: GUI
Reactive BHS

Parks classic BHS (panel + fills), health, stam, psy, and SidHUD rad off-screen. BHS stays type 2 so pieces are not destroyed. Status icons use separate gates. Turn Medik Status icons ON if Medik is installed. Align Medik psy hide with the psy toggle below.
Hide body/limb health
Park the BHS panel background and limb fills together (one visual unit in GAMMA). Shown with the full HUD on damage, hold key, or when HP/psy/rad thresholds trigger.
Show HUD key (hold)
Unpark body/limbs, health, psy, rad, and stamina while held. Status icons stay separate. No key bound by default.
Show HUD on damage
Unpark body/limbs, health, psy, rad, and stamina after a hit. Status icons stay separate. Duration below; 0 disables.
Shown duration (seconds)
How long the damage HUD stays unparked after a hit. Further hits refresh the timer. 0 = off.
Full-heal clamp (seconds)
If all limbs heal to full during a damage flash, remaining show time is clamped to this value. 0 = hide immediately when full.
Hide health bar
Park the BHS actor health bar. Comes back with the full HUD on damage/hold or when any of the HP/psy/rad thresholds fire.
Show full HUD when health below (%)
When actor health is under this percent, show the full HUD pack (body, HP, psy, rad, stam). Stamina-only drain does not do this.
Hide stamina bar
Park the BHS stamina bar. Shows with the full HUD on damage/hold/HP/psy/rad triggers, or alone when stamina is below its threshold.
Show stamina below (%)
Unpark only the stamina bar while power is under this percent. Does not bring up the rest of the HUD.
Hide psy bar
Park the maingame psy bar. Comes back with the full HUD on damage/hold or HP/psy/rad thresholds. Align Medik psy hide with this.
Show full HUD when psy below (%)
When psy is under this percent, show the full HUD pack (body, HP, psy, rad, stam).
Hide radiation bar
Park the SidHUD radiation bar. Comes back with the full HUD on damage/hold or HP/psy/rad thresholds.
Show full HUD when radiation above (%)
When radiation is above this percent, show the full HUD pack. 0 = any rads trigger it.
Hide status icons
Manage the status icon strip: hide by default, then show only opted-in icons below (and while the status hold key is down).
Show status icons key (hold)
Show opted-in status icons while held, including grey. No key bound by default.
Show radiation when not grey
Allow the radiation status icon when yellow or worse. Grey uses the grace slider at the bottom.
Show bleed when not grey
Allow the bleed status icon (Actor Damage Balancer) when yellow or worse.
Show hunger when not grey
Allow the hunger status icon when yellow or worse.
Show thirst when not grey
Allow the thirst status icon when yellow or worse.
Show sleep when not grey
Allow the sleep status icon when yellow or worse.
Hide grey status icon after
Seconds to keep a grey (mild) opted-in icon visible after it becomes grey, then hide it. 0 = never show grey. Yellow+ clears the timer.
Thirst blur FX starts at yellow
Thirst screen blur starts at yellow instead of gray. Yellow is a soft flash; orange/red intensity follows deprivation.
